content.comment_body: Is there any way to configure a timer so that it switches something on or off at a specific moment during its countdown? For example, I have a timer set for 8 minutes, but I'd like something to switch on or off during the last minute, and the timer duration can vary based on the input. I tried using a mathematical block, but it didn’t seem to work. If anyone has ideas, please let me know.

That's not possible with the standard timer blocks. You can use an up or down counter combined with an asynchronous pulse generator for the counter input, which you control with a digital signal. Let me provide an example for you.
The attached example isn’t exactly what you requested, but it may be interesting to see as an alternative method.
Maybe I misunderstood your question, but my solution is completely different from the one offered by the previous user. Please check if this helps you move forward.
You could use two timers—one set for 7 minutes and another for 1 minute. Can you specify whether you need a time-on delay or a time-off delay?

@[user_name]: The question raised by the original poster is quite specific. I think your approach and idea are more aligned with what was asked. My suggestion was just to open discussion on what’s possible with [product_name]. Looking forward to seeing your idea. Have a good evening.
It will be a timer off delay, but the issue is that the 8-minute duration isn’t fixed—it can change.

There is a possible solution. You can use VM mode; it lets you use the remaining timer value. See the attachment. Q2 goes High if the remaining time is less than 1 second—you can adjust this to minutes as needed.
That’s a clever solution—a real creative workaround. I picked up a neat trick today, this is what I call thinking outside the box.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants explored ways to trigger an event (like switching on/off) at a certain point before a timer ends, even if the total timer duration changes. While default timer functions do not support intermediate triggers, users proposed creative solutions, such as using counters, multiple timers, and VM mode to monitor the timer's remaining value. The discussion highlighted the value of sharing alternative and innovative methods beyond standard timer capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for timer functions to allow intermediate triggers at any point, especially as timer durations change dynamically.
